source_policy.copyrighted_files_storage: CNKI PDFs, CAJ files, and downloaded full text stay under ignored output or user download folders. They are never committed to source control.

inbox.git_policy: Project downloads use <project>/outputs/inbox/cnki-downloads when a project root exists. The environment fallback inbox is only for smoke tests or manual environment maintenance. Reports may include filenames, size, hashes, and intended actions, but not file contents.

author_affiliation_policy.download_gate: When the user asks for an author at a named institution, the download candidate must carry author-affiliation evidence from advanced CNKI search, detail-page affiliation text, metadata sidecar, or a user-verified project manifest before any batch download or Zotero import.
author_affiliation_policy.failure_action: Stop before download, report the unverified candidates, and ask for a detail-page or advanced-search evidence pass.

acquisition_channels.role: Non-default CNKI candidate sensor. Use only when a live MCP smoke test passes; the default project path is envctl cnki-zotero backed by controlled Chrome/CDP. It does not download files or write Zotero.
Use agent-browser or Chrome DevTools to attach to the user's already logged-in Chrome session, then discover candidates and trigger CNKI PDF/CAJ downloads for files the user is allowed to access.
Use CNKI export metadata, RIS, EndNote, or a user-provided sidecar file to enrich Zotero records.
Write verified DOI records or local PDF files into Zotero after explicit import action.

zotero_import.primary_write_path: zotero-mcp local connector first; use zotero_add_from_file for local PDFs and zotero_add_by_doi for verified DOI records.
zotero_import.collection_policy: Prefer an existing project collection. If no collection exists, report the fallback target before writing.
post_import_checks: search the newly added Zotero item by title or DOI
keep CAJ files as manual-review attachments unless a trusted conversion path exists

validation_gates.description: The file must come from the user's legal CNKI access or an openly available source.
validation_gates.failure_action: Do not download, import, or attach the file.

validation_gates.description: Do not persist browser cookies, credentials, tokens, or captcha artifacts into the repository.
validation_gates.failure_action: Stop and ask the user to handle login in the browser.

validation_gates.description: When CNKI shows a slider or security verification page, stop automation, write captcha_checkpoint.resume_candidates, and resume only after the user handles verification in the visible logged-in browser.
validation_gates.failure_action: Do not keep retrying the batch; preserve the interrupted queue and wait for manual confirmation.

validation_gates.description: Downloaded full text must stay in ignored output or user download folders.
validation_gates.failure_action: Move the file to an ignored inbox before scanning.

validation_gates.description: Formal references still require citation evidence and metadata verification. DOI is verified when present in the evidence; CNKI records, complete PDFs, and user-provided metadata can serve as DOI-waiver evidence when DOI is absent.
validation_gates.failure_action: Keep the record as a candidate or local attachment, not a formal reference.

validation_gates.description: Zotero writes require an explicit import action or a generated import plan reviewed in the current thread.

external_references.name: cookjohn/cnki-skills
accepted_patterns: browser-session based CNKI discovery and download after user login
field-flexible CNKI search with explicit sort order before batch download
detail-page referrer-preserving PDF/CAJ download through a controllable browser
captcha checkpoint and resume queue instead of repeated failed batch retries
CNKI export metadata before Zotero write
Zotero local connector as the first write path
batch export to reduce repeated page navigation
rejected_patterns: copying upstream scripts wholesale without local schema
bypassing CNKI login, captcha, or access restrictions
treating metadata export as DOI verification
